title: Forty-one Thursdays
subtitle: 地址与通信 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地址与通信（生活与学习·通信与地址）
meta: 主题语境：地址与通信（生活与学习·通信与地址）　|　核心词汇：address　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 address 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 we moved and my father wrote the new ① address on eight cards and sent them to eight people, and my uncle wrote back to the old one for nine years and never understood why nothing came. An address, my mother said, is the only thing a house has that is not the house, and the address, she said, was the true thing we had lost.

He ② addressed the letters to the old house every Thursday, forty-one of them in the first year alone, and my mother kept every one and never answered any. There was ③ a form of address he had used since 1946, 'Dear Sir', to his own brother, and she said the address in a letter is the last thing people give up.

At my aunt's wedding in 1969 he stood and gave the ④ address, and it was eight minutes long and about the post, and nobody has ever mentioned it since; an address, he said, should be shorter than the thing it is about. In 1998 the ⑤ address of that house, which I found on a screen, was a row of numbers I wrote down and never used, and he had sent forty-one letters to the same place without a number on any of them.

My mother sent a ⑥ change of address card in 1975 to a house that had been pulled down in 1971, and the card came back with one word on it and she kept it for thirty-one years. The council never ⑦ addressed the problem of the lane, which flooded eight times in nine years, and she said an address on a form is not the same as being answered.

The  address I keep now is the one he used, written forty-one times on forty-one envelopes, in the same hand, to a house that is not there. The ⑧ address he gave at the wedding, eight minutes about the post, is the only speech of his anybody can still recite. The  address on the last card, which came back in 1975, is the only one of his I have ever been able to read twice.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. （电子邮件的）地址；网址
D. n. 称呼；谈吐（a form of address）
E. 固定搭配：address sth. to sb. 把……寄给／写给某人（动词）
F. 固定搭配：address a problem / issue 处理；对付（动词）
G. 固定搭配：give / deliver an address 发表演说
H. 固定搭配：a change of address 住址变更

items.q: the new address on eight cards
addressed the letters to the old house
a form of address he had used
gave the address, and it was eight minutes
addressed the problem of the lane
The address he gave at the wedding

answers.why: address 意为“地址、住址”，1966 年搬家时父亲把新地址写在八张卡片上。
address sth. to ... 意为“把……寄给”，叔叔每个星期四都把信寄到那座老房子。
a form of address 意为“称呼方式”，他从 1946 年起就对自己的亲兄弟用“亲爱的先生”这种称呼。
give an address 意为“发表演说”，1969 年姑姑婚礼上他站起来致辞，讲了八分钟。
address 意为“网址、（电子）地址”，1998 年我在屏幕上找到那座房子，网址是一串数字。
a change of address 意为“住址变更”，1975 年母亲寄出的变更住址通知卡送到了一座已拆掉的房子。
address a problem 意为“处理问题”，议会从未处理过那条巷子的积水问题。
address 意为“演说、致辞”，他在婚礼上那段八分钟的致辞是唯一还被人背诵的。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年我们搬家，父亲把新地址写在八张卡片上，寄给了八个人。（address）
他每个星期四都把信寄到那座老房子，光第一年就有四十一封。（address sth. to）
1969 年姑姑的婚礼上他站起来致辞，讲了八分钟，讲的都是邮政。（give an address）
1998 年我在屏幕上找到那座房子，它的网址是一串数字。（address）
1975 年母亲往一座 1971 年就已拆掉的房子寄了变更住址通知卡。（a change of address）
议会从未处理过那条巷子的问题，九年里它淹了八次。（address a problem）
answers: In 1966 we moved and my father wrote the new address on eight cards and sent them to eight people.
He addressed the letters to the old house every Thursday, forty-one of them in the first year alone.
At my aunt's wedding in 1969 he stood and gave an address, eight minutes long and all about the post.
In 1998 the address of that house, which I found on a screen, was a row of numbers.
In 1975 my mother sent a change of address card to a house that had been pulled down in 1971.
The council never addressed the problem of the lane, which flooded eight times in nine years.
